claim: AI will take all our jobs.
scope: All jobs, everywhere, with no time limit.
occurrence: CNN headline “Elon Musk says AI will take all our jobs” (Samantha Murphy Kelly, May 23, 2024), reporting Musk at VivaTech in Paris: “Probably none of us will have a job.” Inspected through WRAL’s syndicated copy.

P1.reason: A prediction; no distinct problem with how current evidence is described.

P2.reason: Goes from tasks AI can help with to every job. The US Bureau of Labor Statistics says AI exposure is not a job-loss probability, and national data show no clear broad disruption so far.

P3.reason: States as certain what Musk himself put as “probably”, with no conditions or timeline. Even the narrower half-of-entry-level-jobs warning is a conditional scenario.

W1.reason: “Take” is ordinary wording; the scope and certainty problems are scored above.

W2.reason: Ordinary shorthand for employers using AI; no false mechanism.

review_status: AI research draft; not independently reviewed
note: Headline claim added October 6, 2026 at Leyla’s request for spicier headlines. Scored with the same claims-us-1.0 rubric; evidence comes from the topic research brief.
